The Illinois Environmental Protection Agency issued the final construction permit and Prevention of Significant Deterioration approval on October 14, 2026. The permit covers one combustion turbine with a duct burner and a heat recovery steam generator, rated at 452 MW gross at ISO conditions. The plant serves the Archer Daniels Midland east Decatur complex and sells the rest into the Midcontinent Independent System Operator market. No financing decision or construction start has been reported.

BL 2026/10: A Power magazine article from October 23, 2025 reports that Google signed a power purchase agreement for the plant. https://www.powermag.com/google-backs-first-u-s-gas-fired-power-plant-with-integrated-ccs-for-data-centers/

AM 4/13/26: Illinois EPA proposed a draft air construction permit / PSD approval for the project. https://oilandgaswatch.org/alert/dd7b8d37-3702-4a25-868e-be0f06045a1f

Project financing expected to reach final investment decision in Q2 2026
NF 5/21/25: Construction to begin in 2026.
NF 6/3/24: Construction agreement signed between ADM and Warwick in Oct 2023. NF: Pre-FEED stage (Front-End Engineering Design) for the CCS project. 
Jenny: filed interconnection app in Feb 2022

fields.Status Detail:
The Illinois Environmental Protection Agency first issued the construction permit on July 29, 2022, extended it on January 22, 2024 and extended it again on July 21, 2025. The second extension requires construction to begin by January 21, 2027. The 2021 permit application described the plant at about 1,100 MW. An Illinois Times article reports that in August 2026 the developer of the Eagle Rock data center in Christian County, which was to buy the plant's power, abandoned that project.

https://webapps.illinois.gov/EPA/WebSiteApi/api/PublicNotices/GetAirPermitDocument/9857
https://webapps.illinois.gov/EPA/WebSiteApi/api/PublicNotices/GetAirPermitDocument/9294
https://webapps.illinois.gov/EPA/WebSiteApi/api/PublicNotices/GetAirPermitDocument/7738
https://www.illinoistimes.com/news/data-center-developer-abandons-plans-for-christian-county/

BL: An Illinois Times article carried by the Springfield Business Journal in summer 2026 says construction has not begun. Development control moved back from Kindle Energy to the original developer EmberClear. The Illinois Environmental Protection Agency construction permit was extended twice and now expires on January 1, 2027.

https://www.springfieldbusinessjournal.com/news/data-center-development-linked-to-power-plant-construction/

NF 6/7/24: Construction to begin in Q4 2024. Commissioning in Dec 2027 (EIA) or Jan 2028 (Kindle Energy). No data on the turbine model yet. NF: According to EIA 4/23, the station is planned for installation, but regulatory approvals not initiated. 7/2022 The Illinois Environmental Protection Agency issued a construction permit for the station. It would be able to incorporate 30% hydrogen and up to 100% within the lifespan of this project.
